reason: At base REGEX_FORMAT matches Y{1,4} but format() only implements YY/YYYY, so lone Y and YYY fall through to the timezone-offset fallback (zoneStr) instead of being preserved literally, so the expected output is not produced.
After the fix REGEX_FORMAT no longer matches lone Y or YYY, so they stay as literal text; format('Y')->'Y' and format('YYY')->YY+'Y' as expected.
Pure refactor of percent-decoding into tryDecodeURIComponent with identical behavior; the %20 route param is still decoded to a space.
Same refactor applied; tryDecodeURIComponent performs the same 'contains %' check and decode, so decoding still works.
At base reschedule() does zincrby but never updates @score, so entry.score/entry.at return the stale pre-reschedule value and the assert_in_delta on the new time fails.
The fix adds @score = at.to_f after zincrby, so the same in-memory handle now reports the new rescheduled time.
PR only changes parseRangesSpecifier whitespace trimming; Content-Type charset parsing is untouched and behaves as before (test unrelated to the change).
Range-header whitespace change does not affect Content-Type parsing; the charset header still reports text/plain with UTF-8.
PR only alters Composer repository error/warning message text; archiving zip timestamp preservation is entirely unrelated and unchanged.
Logging-only change in ComposerRepository does not affect archive creation; timestamps still match source and never 1980.
CredentialCacheKey.IsPrefix change is in System.Net; async JSON deserialization of nullable parent properties is unrelated and works.
Credential-cache URI comparison change cannot affect JsonSerializer sync/async deserialization equivalence.
Cursor FETCH FIRST fix is unrelated to INET containment operators; '<<=' ANY still parses and returns true.
SQL cursor fix does not touch INET operator parsing; '>>=' ANY over an INET[] array still works.
At base every NO_PROXY entry gets prefixed as all://*::1, a malformed URL the proxy parsing cannot interpret, so client construction errors out rather than succeeding.
is_ipv6_hostname recognizes ::1 and mounts all://[::1], so client creation succeeds and the bypass is applied without error.
At base match() with flags other than IGNORECASE compiles the pattern then compares full flag sets against pat.flags, raising ValueError, so the DOTALL call is rejected instead of honored.
The fix only compares/keeps IGNORECASE from flags, so a DOTALL pattern 'a.c' now matches 'a\nc' and not 'ac', via flags= or a compiled pat.
At base freezing a chain with a group in the middle corrupts result parents (recursive parent bug), so the serialized/reconstructed result tree would not preserve separate children for both groups.
Fix updates prev_task/prev_res after a group so chains with intervening groups build correct links; reconstructed result tree keeps every child result in both groups.
The reported bug only affects a leading '--'; with values before the terminator, '--' hands off '--check' to the second positional, so base behaves correctly here.
After the fix the current positional's value_terminator takes precedence even when '--' is first; first gets value1/value2 and second gets --check.
At base a post-startup OSC11 response sets 'background' via nvim_set_option_value, which does trigger OptionSet (and reloads the colorscheme firing ColorScheme), matching the expected result.

The fix wraps the background set in :noautocmd, so the late-arriving OSC11 response updates 'background' without firing OptionSet (and suppresses the ColorScheme event), contrary to the test expectation.
The schema change only reorders compile-time @derive reads for Inspect; runtime required-field validation on changesets is unaffected.
Compile-time caching reorder of @derive does not change changeset cast/validate behavior, so the omitted required field still marks the changeset invalid with a blank error.
